screens.title: UI-06 Library - Shelves - Veritalex
screens.prompt:
Design UI-06 Library - Shelves, an authentic native Android portrait screen (412x915 baseline) for Veritalex following Material 3 / Material You guidelines and DESIGN.md.

Visual atmosphere & theme:
- Warm paper palette: surface #FFF8F3 / #FFF8F5, warm containers #FCF1E8, #F5E9DF, brand accent seed #895021, text on-surface #241A14, text on-surface-variant #55483D, outline #857468 / #D7C3B4.
- Typography: Roboto Flex for all UI elements and labels. Clean sentence-case, dignified hierarchy.

Screen Layout & Content:
1. Status Bar:
   - Native Android status bar (time 9:41, wifi, battery, cellular).
2. Top App Bar:
   - Headline "Library" (24/32 medium), trailing settings icon button (48dp touch target).
   - Sync status indicator beneath or adjacent: cloud icon with "Up to date" (small factual text).
3. Primary Library Tabs:
   - Segmented / underline tabs: "Books", "Shelves" (selected with active warm amber indicator / weight), "Journal".
4. Content Section Header:
   - Title: "Your shelves" with quiet explanatory line beneath: "Your own way to organize a good read."
   - Action: "New shelf" with plus icon button/pill, minimum 48dp comfortable touch target.
5. Three Personal Shelf Rows:
   - Each shelf row is an elegant, readable row or subtle card:
     a) "Weekend reads" — 3 books. Shows overlapping grouping of 3 miniature dignified book covers (approx 2:3 ratio): "Pride and Prejudice" (Austen), "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland" (Carroll), "Frankenstein" (Shelley). Book count label ("3 books") and trailing 'more_vert' icon button.
     b) "Classics to revisit" — 2 books. Mini overlapping covers: "Jane Eyre" (Bronte) and "Frankenstein" (Shelley). Book count label ("2 books") and trailing 'more_vert' icon button.
     c) "Curious minds" — 1 book. Single mini cover: "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland" (Carroll). Book count label ("1 book") and trailing 'more_vert' icon button.
   - Covers have realistic classic typography styling matching Veritalex standards (Gutenberg styled covers with dark rich covers: deep burgundy/brown, dark green/gothic, deep violet, dark espresso). Soft 4dp corner radius.
   - Avoid huge blank cards or excessive emptiness. Balanced, breathable vertical rhythm.
6. Bottom Navigation Bar:
   - Fixed Material 3 bottom navigation: "Home" (auto_stories), "Explore" (explore), "Library" (local_library - selected with tonal pill indicator).
   - Android navigation gesture bar inset at the bottom.

No marketing hero, no social feed, no invented statistics or star ratings here. Exactly one clean portrait mobile screen.

The aesthetic style is a refined, content-first **Corporate / Modern** execution tailored for literature:
- **Atmospheric Warmth:** Built on warm paper tones and rich amber-brown seed colors rather than cold corporate neutrals.
- **Utilitarian Clarity:** Strict adherence to native Android component behavior with generous whitespace and zero decorative fluff.
- **Distraction-Free Focus:** Complete absence of marketing heroes, dashboard metrics, social feeds, or gradients.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model follows a fluid Android phone baseline (optimized for 412dp, validating down to 360dp) utilizing edge-to-edge display with safe status and navigation insets. 

- **Grid & Gutters:** Content uses 20dp gutters (16dp on compact viewports). 
- **Spacing Rhythm:** Based on a strict 4dp/8dp scale (`4`, `8`, `12`, `16`, `24`, `32dp`), ensuring consistent vertical rhythm between section headers, book rows, and shelves.
- **Form Factors:** On tablets, the layout expands gracefully using a navigation rail and intentional list/detail panes, restricting the central reading measure to an optimal 60-70 characters per line. Top bars are structured at 64dp and bottom navigation at 80dp plus system insets.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is conveyed primarily through **Tonal Layers** rather than heavy drop shadows. 
- **Surface Tiers:** UI elements stack cleanly using the warm paper surface container hierarchy (`surface-container-low`, `surface-container`, `surface-container-high`).
- **Shadows:** Applied strictly as transient overlays for floating action buttons, active bottom sheets, or dialog modals. 
- **Borders & Outlines:** Low-contrast outlines (`#857468`, `#D7C3B4`) bound interactive elements cleanly without card-in-card visual noise.

- **Buttons:** Filled, tonal, and text variants with a pill main action shape. All interactive touch targets maintain a strict minimum of 48dp. Icon buttons have explicit 48dp bounds.

screens.prompt:
Design TAB-03 Journal list and entry detail for Veritalex on Android tablet landscape (1280x900 resolution viewport).
Material 3 design system with warm paper palette (#FFF8F3, containers #FCF1E8, #F5E9DF, #EEE1D5, text #241A14, primary warm amber/brown #895021). Roboto Flex for all UI elements and metadata, Literata serif for quotes and literary excerpts.

Structure:
1. Android Tablet System Bar (top 10:42 AM, wifi, battery icons).
2. Navigation Rail (left 88px-96px width docked full height):
   - Top: Veritalex monogram book icon + subtle wordmark
   - Nav items: Home (icon), Explore (icon), Library (local_library icon, actively selected with pill container indicator)
   - Bottom: Settings icon button
3. Main Content Area (divided with top Library header and two-pane master-detail body):
   - Library Header:
     - Title 'Library' with cloud icon 'Up to date'
     - Tabs: 'Books', 'Shelves', 'Journal' (Journal actively selected with amber indicator underline)
     - Right: Search input field / actions
   - Master-Detail Split Layout (Clean vertical divider):
     - LEFT PANE (Master list ~40% width, min 380px):
       - Header row: 'Reading journal' headline, search icon button, and '+ New entry' pill button (tonal or primary container).
       - Filter chips: 'All entries' (active selected chip), 'Notes', 'Quotes'.
       - 3 Journal list entries:
         1. Pride and Prejudice (Jane Austen) - Chapter 18 - Quote & note badge. Quote snippet: "The moment of her release from him was ecstasy." Note preview: "Elizabeth's relief says more than her politeness ever could." State: Selected item (highlighted with soft container tint / subtle active border).
         2. Frankenstein (Mary Shelley) - Added yesterday - Note badge. Note: "Who is responsible for what we create?"
         3. Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (Lewis Carroll) - Chapter 2 - Quote badge. Quote: "Curiouser and curiouser!"
     - RIGHT PANE (Detail view ~60% width):
       - Editor-like calm, reading-room aesthetic.
       - Top bar of detail pane: Book title 'Pride and Prejudice' by Jane Austen, Chapter 18, saved date/time, and action buttons (Edit entry icon button, More options icon button).
       - Book badge/cover thumbnail preview (Gutenberg 1342, Pride and Prejudice, deep burgundy cover) alongside book metadata.
       - Quote section: Styled beautifully in Literata serif italic with warm quotation bar / blockquote styling:
         “The moment of her release from him was ecstasy.”
       - Private note section:
         Label: 'Private note'
         Text: "Elizabeth's relief says more than her politeness ever could."
       - Metadata tags: Badges for 'Chapter 18', '28% read position', 'Quote & note'.
       - Action: Prominent primary button or tonal button with book icon: 'Return to passage' (with right arrow icon or book icon).
       - Secondary options: 'Share entry', 'Copy quote'.

No phone bottom nav. Tablet landscape orientation. Generous whitespace, refined typography, and strict Material 3 guidelines.

       * Great Expectations by Charles Dickens (Gutenberg 1400, 54k readers)

       * Moby-Dick by Herman Melville (Gutenberg 2701, 42k readers)

   - Prominent Material 3 search bar: container shape rounded-full / 28dp, background surface-container-low or surface-container, border subtle outline-variant or flat tonal.

   - Section title "Browse by subject" (text-title-medium, text-on-surface, medium weight).
   - Compact two-column grid of subject tiles:
     1. Fiction (icon: "menu_book")
     2. Mystery (icon: "search") or "visibility" / "fingerprint"
     3. Romance (icon: "favorite_border")
     4. Adventure (icon: "explore" or "compass_calibration" or "terrain")
     5. Philosophy (icon: "psychology" or "lightbulb")
     6. Poetry (icon: "feather" or "draw" or "auto_awesome")
   - Style: Tonal cards with rounded-2xl (16dp), surface-container-low background, text-on-surface medium labels, subtle Material icons in primary (#895021) or on-surface-variant. Strictly NO decorative photography or flashy gradients. Clean, tactile, elegant touch targets.
5. Section: "Popular classics"
   - Section title: "Popular classics" (text-title-medium, text-on-surface).
   - Subtitle / quietly integrated attribution: "From Project Gutenberg catalogue"
   - Book rows / list:

   - "Public domain editions via Project Gutenberg & Veritalex Archives" centered at the bottom of the scrollable content.

   - 3 destinations:

     - Library (icon: "local_library", inactive)
   - Fixed docked bottom-0 with standard Android gesture navigation bar indicator pill inset.

Strictly calm, personal reading room matching screens UI-01, UI-02, UI-03, UI-04. Uncluttered whitespace, native Material 3 interactions, authentic Project Gutenberg typesetting covers.

## Brand & Style
This design system embodies a dark, immersive reading companion experience, tailored for literary focus and quiet contemplation. Drawing from a Corporate / Modern and Material 3 inspired aesthetic, the personality is grounded, intellectual, and serene. It evokes the intimate feeling of reading by a warm lamp in a quiet room, utilizing deep, warm near-black brown surfaces and soft ink text.

## Layout & Spacing
The layout employs a responsive fluid grid designed around a 412x915 phone baseline, scaling gracefully down to 360px. Spacing relies on a consistent 4dp/8dp rhythm. Tone-separated groups and subtle dividers replace dense card walls to maintain an uncrowded, calm interface. Complete native status bar and gesture safe insets are preserved at all times.

## Elevation & Depth
Elevation is expressed through tonal layering rather than hard drop shadows or bright surfaces. The interface builds depth by stepping through dark surface container tiers (`surface-container-low`, `surface-container`, `surface-container-high`). Outlines and subtle variants provide boundary definition without introducing visual noise.

## Components
- **Buttons:** Main actions feature pill-shaped containers utilizing primary amber fills with dark brown text labels. Secondary actions use tonal outlines. All interactive targets meet a minimum of 48dp height.
- **Cards:** Clean, unbordered surfaces utilizing `surface-container` tiers with 16dp corner radii. No bright white backgrounds. Book cover art remains completely unaltered.
- **Input Fields:** Dark background fills (`surface-container-low`) with subtle outline variants and soft warm ink placeholder text.
- **Lists & Dividers:** Tone-separated groupings divided by subtle `outline-variant` lines instead of heavy card walls.
- **Navigation:** Bottom navigation bars and top app bars blend seamlessly into the dark surface hierarchy, hiding appropriately during immersive reading states.
- **Sheets:** Bottom sheets feature a 28dp top corner radius and contain contextual reading controls, chapter indexes, or metadata previews.

## Brand & Style

The brand personality is scholarly, deliberate, warm, and focused entirely on the intimacy of text. It evokes the quiet focus of a personal study or a well-lit library alcove. 

The aesthetic style is a refined, content-first **Corporate / Modern** execution tailored for literature:
- **Atmospheric Warmth:** Built on warm paper tones and rich amber-brown seed colors rather than cold corporate neutrals.
- **Utilitarian Clarity:** Strict adherence to native Android component behavior with generous whitespace and zero decorative fluff.
- **Distraction-Free Focus:** Complete absence of marketing heroes, dashboard metrics, social feeds, or gradients.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model follows a fluid Android phone baseline (optimized for 412dp, validating down to 360dp) utilizing edge-to-edge display with safe status and navigation insets. 

- **Grid & Gutters:** Content uses 20dp gutters (16dp on compact viewports). 
- **Spacing Rhythm:** Based on a strict 4dp/8dp scale (`4`, `8`, `12`, `16`, `24`, `32dp`), ensuring consistent vertical rhythm between section headers, book rows, and shelves.
- **Form Factors:** On tablets, the layout expands gracefully using a navigation rail and intentional list/detail panes, restricting the central reading measure to an optimal 60-70 characters per line. Top bars are structured at 64dp and bottom navigation at 80dp plus system insets.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is conveyed primarily through **Tonal Layers** rather than heavy drop shadows. 
- **Surface Tiers:** UI elements stack cleanly using the warm paper surface container hierarchy (`surface-container-low`, `surface-container`, `surface-container-high`).
- **Shadows:** Applied strictly as transient overlays for floating action buttons, active bottom sheets, or dialog modals. 
- **Borders & Outlines:** Low-contrast outlines (`#857468`, `#D7C3B4`) bound interactive elements cleanly without card-in-card visual noise.

## Components

Components follow native Material 3 guidelines, emphasizing functional clarity and touch ergonomics:

- **Buttons:** Filled, tonal, and text variants with a pill main action shape. All interactive touch targets maintain a strict minimum of 48dp. Icon buttons have explicit 48dp bounds.
- **Navigation:** Bottom navigation uses labeled destinations with a selected tonal pill indicator. The app features three primary destinations (Home, Explore, Library), with Settings housed as a toolbar action.
- **Cards & Lists:** `BookCoverCard` components preserve accurate 2:3 portrait dimensions with dignified typeset fallbacks. `BookListRow` and `ShelfRow` components use flat tonal grouping with generous section spacing.
- **Reader Interface:** Distraction-free text view with access to the `ReaderToolbar` and `ReaderAppearanceSheet` on tap. Supports continuous scroll and page modes seamlessly.
- **State & Feedback:** Clear, factual status components (`DownloadState`, `SyncStatusRow`, `EmptyState`, `RetryState`) that keep users informed of offline capability and device sync status without exposing backend jargon.

# Veritalex - Night

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a calm, personal reading sanctuary rooted in the principles of Material 3 and Material You. The brand personality is scholarly, deliberate, warm, and focused entirely on the intimacy of text. It evokes the quiet focus of a personal study or a well-lit library alcove. 

The aesthetic style is a refined, content-first **Corporate / Modern** execution tailored for literature:
- **Atmospheric Warmth:** Built on warm paper tones and rich amber-brown seed colors rather than cold corporate neutrals.
- **Utilitarian Clarity:** Strict adherence to native Android component behavior with generous whitespace and zero decorative fluff.
- **Distraction-Free Focus:** Complete absence of marketing heroes, dashboard metrics, social feeds, or gradients.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model follows a fluid Android phone baseline (optimized for 412dp, validating down to 360dp) utilizing edge-to-edge display with safe status and navigation insets. 

- **Grid & Gutters:** Content uses 20dp gutters (16dp on compact viewports). 
- **Spacing Rhythm:** Based on a strict 4dp/8dp scale (`4`, `8`, `12`, `16`, `24`, `32dp`), ensuring consistent vertical rhythm between section headers, book rows, and shelves.
- **Form Factors:** On tablets, the layout expands gracefully using a navigation rail and intentional list/detail panes, restricting the central reading measure to an optimal 60-70 characters per line. Top bars are structured at 64dp and bottom navigation at 80dp plus system insets.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is conveyed primarily through **Tonal Layers** rather than heavy drop shadows. 
- **Surface Tiers:** UI elements stack cleanly using the warm paper surface container hierarchy (`surface-container-low`, `surface-container`, `surface-container-high`).
- **Shadows:** Applied strictly as transient overlays for floating action buttons, active bottom sheets, or dialog modals. 
- **Borders & Outlines:** Low-contrast outlines (`#857468`, `#D7C3B4`) bound interactive elements cleanly without card-in-card visual noise.

## Components

Components follow native Material 3 guidelines, emphasizing functional clarity and touch ergonomics:

- **Buttons:** Filled, tonal, and text variants with a pill main action shape. All interactive touch targets maintain a strict minimum of 48dp. Icon buttons have explicit 48dp bounds.
- **Navigation:** Bottom navigation uses labeled destinations with a selected tonal pill indicator. The app features three primary destinations (Home, Explore, Library), with Settings housed as a toolbar action.
- **Cards & Lists:** `BookCoverCard` components preserve accurate 2:3 portrait dimensions with dignified typeset fallbacks. `BookListRow` and `ShelfRow` components use flat tonal grouping with generous section spacing.
- **Reader Interface:** Distraction-free text view with access to the `ReaderToolbar` and `ReaderAppearanceSheet` on tap. Supports continuous scroll and page modes seamlessly.
- **State & Feedback:** Clear, factual status components (`DownloadState`, `SyncStatusRow`, `EmptyState`, `RetryState`) that keep users informed of offline capability and device sync status without exposing backend jargon.

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a calm, personal reading sanctuary rooted in the principles of Material 3 and Material You. The brand personality is scholarly, deliberate, warm, and focused entirely on the intimacy of text. It evokes the quiet focus of a personal study or a well-lit library alcove. 

The aesthetic style is a refined, content-first **Corporate / Modern** execution tailored for literature:
- **Atmospheric Warmth:** Built on warm paper tones and rich amber-brown seed colors rather than cold corporate neutrals.
- **Utilitarian Clarity:** Strict adherence to native Android component behavior with generous whitespace and zero decorative fluff.
- **Distraction-Free Focus:** Complete absence of marketing heroes, dashboard metrics, social feeds, or gradients.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model follows a fluid Android phone baseline (optimized for 412dp, validating down to 360dp) utilizing edge-to-edge display with safe status and navigation insets. 

- **Grid & Gutters:** Content uses 20dp gutters (16dp on compact viewports). 
- **Spacing Rhythm:** Based on a strict 4dp/8dp scale (`4`, `8`, `12`, `16`, `24`, `32dp`), ensuring consistent vertical rhythm between section headers, book rows, and shelves.
- **Form Factors:** On tablets, the layout expands gracefully using a navigation rail and intentional list/detail panes, restricting the central reading measure to an optimal 60-70 characters per line. Top bars are structured at 64dp and bottom navigation at 80dp plus system insets.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is conveyed primarily through **Tonal Layers** rather than heavy drop shadows. 
- **Surface Tiers:** UI elements stack cleanly using the warm paper surface container hierarchy (`surface-container-low`, `surface-container`, `surface-container-high`).
- **Shadows:** Applied strictly as transient overlays for floating action buttons, active bottom sheets, or dialog modals. 
- **Borders & Outlines:** Low-contrast outlines (`#857468`, `#D7C3B4`) bound interactive elements cleanly without card-in-card visual noise.

## Components

Components follow native Material 3 guidelines, emphasizing functional clarity and touch ergonomics:

- **Buttons:** Filled, tonal, and text variants with a pill main action shape. All interactive touch targets maintain a strict minimum of 48dp. Icon buttons have explicit 48dp bounds.
- **Navigation:** Bottom navigation uses labeled destinations with a selected tonal pill indicator. The app features three primary destinations (Home, Explore, Library), with Settings housed as a toolbar action.
- **Cards & Lists:** `BookCoverCard` components preserve accurate 2:3 portrait dimensions with dignified typeset fallbacks. `BookListRow` and `ShelfRow` components use flat tonal grouping with generous section spacing.
- **Reader Interface:** Distraction-free text view with access to the `ReaderToolbar` and `ReaderAppearanceSheet` on tap. Supports continuous scroll and page modes seamlessly.
- **State & Feedback:** Clear, factual status components (`DownloadState`, `SyncStatusRow`, `EmptyState`, `RetryState`) that keep users informed of offline capability and device sync status without exposing backend jargon.

## Brand & Style
This design system embodies a dark, immersive reading companion experience, tailored for literary focus and quiet contemplation. Drawing from a Corporate / Modern and Material 3 inspired aesthetic, the personality is grounded, intellectual, and serene. It evokes the intimate feeling of reading by a warm lamp in a quiet room, utilizing deep, warm near-black brown surfaces and soft ink text.

## Layout & Spacing
The layout employs a responsive fluid grid designed around a 412x915 phone baseline, scaling gracefully down to 360px. Spacing relies on a consistent 4dp/8dp rhythm. Tone-separated groups and subtle dividers replace dense card walls to maintain an uncrowded, calm interface. Complete native status bar and gesture safe insets are preserved at all times.

## Elevation & Depth
Elevation is expressed through tonal layering rather than hard drop shadows or bright surfaces. The interface builds depth by stepping through dark surface container tiers (`surface-container-low`, `surface-container`, `surface-container-high`). Outlines and subtle variants provide boundary definition without introducing visual noise.

## Components
- **Buttons:** Main actions feature pill-shaped containers utilizing primary amber fills with dark brown text labels. Secondary actions use tonal outlines. All interactive targets meet a minimum of 48dp height.
- **Cards:** Clean, unbordered surfaces utilizing `surface-container` tiers with 16dp corner radii. No bright white backgrounds. Book cover art remains completely unaltered.
- **Input Fields:** Dark background fills (`surface-container-low`) with subtle outline variants and soft warm ink placeholder text.
- **Lists & Dividers:** Tone-separated groupings divided by subtle `outline-variant` lines instead of heavy card walls.
- **Navigation:** Bottom navigation bars and top app bars blend seamlessly into the dark surface hierarchy, hiding appropriately during immersive reading states.
- **Sheets:** Bottom sheets feature a 28dp top corner radius and contain contextual reading controls, chapter indexes, or metadata previews.

   - Flat background seamlessly matching surface, no heavy shadow.

   - Compact horizontal card or summary section with book cover for 'Pride and Prejudice' by Jane Austen (deep burgundy/plum classic Gutenberg cover style with 'GUTENBERG 1342', 'Pride and Prejudice', 'Jane Austen', 'CLASSIC').
   - Book title 'Pride and Prejudice' in font-medium, author 'Jane Austen' in muted secondary text.

3. Main Headline & Context:
   - Primary heading: "Where would you like to continue?" (Roboto Flex 24/32 medium, ink color #241A14).
   - Context explanation: "This book was read in two places before syncing." (15/22 text-on-surface-variant, gentle, non-blaming tone).

4. Position Comparison Radio Choice Cards:
   - Two distinct, tactile native Android radio list cards / selector rows:
     * Option A (Currently Selected):
       - Radio button in active selected state (Material 3 radio with primary amber-brown #895021 fill and inner dot).
       - Card styled with selected highlight: slightly warmer container background (bg-surface-container-low or subtle primary-container border/tint, rounded-2xl p-4).
       - Title: "This device" (font-medium text-base text-on-surface).

       - Radio button in unselected state (circular outline).
       - Card styled with standard surface-container background, rounded-2xl p-4.
       - Title: "Your other device" (font-medium text-base text-on-surface).
       - Details: "Chapter 20" • "31% read".

- Absolutely NO technical error jargon (no 'conflict hash', 'merge error', 'server 409', 'overwrite warning', or blame).
- No arbitrary clock timestamps or fake community data.

- Tactile, accessible targets with generous padding and crisp hierarchy.

   - Connected provider tag/chip: Google icon or clean "Connected with Google" pill badge with subtle checkmark.

   - Prominent but calm, restrained card or section.
